verses.1: To David, the wise man, who was full of sin and wickedness.
verses.2: Men’s actions do not consider God to be a threat to them; their hearts are not full of pride.
verses.3: For I have exhausted myself in my crying all day long.
verses.4: For day and night, your hand will protect me; I will be transformed into a “Shadi” in the midst of the destruction of Qayit Selah.
verses.5: I have sinned against you. I have not covered my sins. I said, “I will bear the punishment for my sins before Jehovah.” But you have brought upon me the punishment for my sins.
verses.6: Therefore, every believer should pray to You. When they come to You, they can only pour out their sins before You. None of those sins will be accepted by You.
verses.7: You are a secret to me; you hide me from all dangers. You protect me from all harm.
verses.8: I will watch over you, and my eyes will be upon you as you walk in this path.
verses.9: Do not be like those who are divided into factions. They do not understand the principles of wisdom. They are far from being worthy of your attention.
verses.10: Many are sad for the wicked and those who trust in God’s mercy.
verses.11: Rejoice in the Lord, and bring forth righteous people. Let us also honor all those who are upright in heart.
